title: stramonium
intro: Stramonium, commonly known as Jimsonweed, is a plant species in the nightshade family, Datura stramonium. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as pain relief and antispasmodic effects. The therapeutic actions of Stramonium include sedation, analgesia, and anticholinergic properties, making it useful for treating conditions like insomnia and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include alkaloids like scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which contribute to its sedative and antispasmodic properties.
